title: ChoraForge Web UI: React SPA
Build feedback loop infrastructure into ChoraForge evolution engine
description: ChoraForge evolution engine needs built-in verification tools as core architecture. Test harness, health checks, metrics collection, screenshot diffing, console watching, and structured result reporting feeding into variant scorer. Castalia is the proving ground.

title: E2E gate runner: setup/run/teardown lifecycle in variant scorer
description: Add E2E gate to evolution engine that manages: 1) Setup command (start test server), 2) Run command (execute test suite), 3) Teardown command (stop server), 4) Timeout handling, 5) Structured pass/fail results fed into variant scoring. Config via evolution.gates.e2e in config.toml.

title: Health check gate: verify app is running before E2E tests
description: HTTP/WebSocket ping that waits for the test server to be ready before running E2E tests. Configurable URL, timeout, and retry interval. Prevents false test failures from slow startup.

title: Metrics collector: read performance thresholds from instrumented app
description: After E2E tests pass, collect runtime metrics (FPS, load time, memory, WebSocket latency) from the app via page.evaluate() or exposed endpoints. Compare against configured thresholds in evolution.gates.e2e.thresholds. Fail variants that regress performance.

title: Console error watcher: catch runtime errors the build misses
description: During E2E test runs, capture browser console errors/warnings. Fail variants that introduce new console errors. Configurable allowlist for known benign warnings.

title: Screenshot differ: visual regression detection via Stagehand
description: Capture before/after screenshots during E2E tests using Stagehand. Compare for visual regressions. Optional gate for UI-heavy projects. Configurable similarity threshold.

title: Castalia proving ground: E2E test suite + ChoraForge integration
description: Castalia is the first project to prove ChoraForge's feedback loop works. Build Playwright E2E tests for core Castalia flows, wire them into ChoraForge's evolution gates, and demonstrate autonomous bug-fixing with real verification.

title: Castalia Playwright test suite: 10 core E2E scenarios
description: Write Playwright E2E tests for Castalia covering: 1) Page loads without errors, 2) Player can join a room, 3) Avatar renders and is visible, 4) Player can move (WASD/arrow keys), 5) Video orb appears when video enabled, 6) Chat messages send/receive, 7) Other players visible in room, 8) Theme switching works, 9) Deep links load correct room, 10) No console errors during basic flow. Tests run against local dev server.

title: Castalia test server harness: just test-server-start/stop
description: Create justfile commands for Castalia that start a test server instance (MongoDB + Express + Colyseus) with test fixtures, wait for health check, and tear down cleanly. Must work headless for CI and ChoraForge gate runner.

title: Castalia performance instrumentation: expose FPS, latency, memory
description: Add window.__castalia_metrics object to Castalia client exposing: Phaser FPS, WebSocket latency, render time, memory usage, active video streams count. Playwright tests can read these via page.evaluate() for performance gate assertions.

title: Wire Castalia as first ChoraForge evolution target
description: Create .ralph-tui/config.toml for Castalia with ChoraForge evolution config: evolution.gates pointing to Playwright tests, evolution.gates.e2e with setup/run/teardown commands, thresholds for FPS and load time. Run first autonomous bug fix cycle end-to-end.
